electric-indigo.$description: Electric Indigo — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, deepest background — the void that all content sits on

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated surface, product preview frames, secondary panels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Deeper overlay surface, hover states on dark cards, input fields

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text, inverted surface, button text, high-contrast foreground

silver.$description: Silver — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle structural edges

pearl.$description: Pearl — Secondary text, subdued headings, placeholder body copy

slate.$description: Slate — Footer borders, low-contrast dividers between dark zones

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, inactive icons, de-emphasized metadata

stone.$description: Stone — Tertiary text, timestamps, supplementary labels

savee-font.$description: The sole typeface — a custom geometric sans used at every scale. Weight 400 carries the editorial body and nav; weight 500 appears on buttons and emphasized labels. The 96px display at 0.96 line-height with -0.04em tracking is the system's signature: it compresses into a dense confident block rather than stretching vertically, making the headline feel sculptural.
